title: North Korea Is Making Meme Coins… With Stolen Binance Money 🕵️
description:
Oct 29, 2026: about $6.4 billion was stolen from Binance between 20:05 and 23:56 UTC. Investigators (Elliptic, TRM Labs) attribute it to North Korea. About $2.85 billion has been frozen or seized; about $3 billion is still in linked wallets. The launderers now use more than 20,000 wallets on 16 blockchains. Their newest trick: worthless meme tokens they create themselves and trade through liquidity pools, so funds never pass directly between wallets. On NEAR, about 117,000 NEAR (~$430,000) went through six home-made tokens. After the 2025 Bybit hack, all 499,000 stolen ETH were laundered within ten days.

Sources: Elliptic, "How North Korea is laundering the $6.4 billion stolen from Binance" (updated Nov 9, 2026); TRM Labs, "Binance Hack Update" (Nov 3, 2026).

Not financial advice. Entertainment and education only.
pinned: Would you check who created a coin before buying it? 👇

scenes.line: North Korea is making its own meme coins. To hide stolen Binance money.
October 29. Hackers took $6.4 billion from Binance in under four hours.
Investigators blame North Korea. About $2.85 billion was frozen in time.
About $3 billion is still out there. Now they are moving it.
The newest trick: worthless meme coins they create themselves.
They trade them through pools. The money never goes wallet to wallet.
On NEAR alone: six home-made tokens. About $430,000 pushed through.
They have done this before. After the Bybit hack, 499,000 ether vanished in ten days.
So when a strange new coin appears overnight, ask who made it.
